name: @omp-dev-team/datadog
description: Datadog observability for OMP via the Datadog 'pup' CLI — one broad skill that drives pup.
comment: Config-only plugin: install.sh/ps1 install the pup CLI (DataDog/pup) and set up auth. The single 'datadog' skill routes everything through pup so OMP's skill list isn't flooded by pup's ~30 embedded domain skills. --with-skills opts into `pup skills install pi`.
